cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolTransforms
import numpy as np
import json
lig=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('n1(-c2ccccn2)c(/C=C/c2ccc(O)cc2)cc(/C=C/c2ccc(O)cc2)n1'))
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=2021
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(lig,params)==0
rdMolTransforms.SetDihedralDeg(lig.GetConformer(),28,0,1,6,0)
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(lig,AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(lig))
ff.MMFFAddTorsionConstraint(28,0,1,6,False,-5,5,30)
ff.MMFFAddDistanceConstraint(6,28,False,2.62,2.75,200)
ff.Initialize(); ff.Minimize(maxIts=2500)
p=lig.GetConformer().GetPositions()
mid=(p[28]+p[6])/2
x=p[28]-p[6]; d=np.linalg.norm(x); x/=d
v=mid-(p[0]+p[1])/2
v-=np.dot(v,x)*x; y=v/np.linalg.norm(v); z=np.cross(x,y)
p=(p-mid)@np.array([x,y,z]).T
h=np.sqrt(2.13**2-(d/2)**2)
p[:,1]-=h
# Rotate chelate to the lower side of the arene cap, with N1 to +x and N3 to -x.
a=np.deg2rad(55)
R=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,np.cos(a),-np.sin(a)],[0,np.sin(a),np.cos(a)]])
p=p@R.T
ar=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('CC(C)c1ccc(C)cc1'))
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(ar,params)==0
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(ar,maxIters=1000)
q=ar.GetConformer().GetPositions(); ring=[at.GetIdx() for at in ar.GetAtoms() if at.GetIsAromatic()]
center=q[ring].mean(0); x=q[3]-center; x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
_,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(q[ring]-center); z=vh[-1]; z/=np.linalg.norm(z); y=np.cross(z,x); y/=np.linalg.norm(y); x=np.cross(y,z)
q=(q-center)@np.array([x,y,z]).T
# Choose an orientation for the para substituents.
a=np.deg2rad(20); R=np.array([[np.cos(a),-np.sin(a),0],[np.sin(a),np.cos(a),0],[0,0,1]])
q=q@R.T; q[:,2]+=1.68
syms=[at.GetSymbol() for at in lig.GetAtoms()]+[at.GetSymbol() for at in ar.GetAtoms()]+['Os','Cl']
nl=lig.GetNumAtoms(); na=ar.GetNumAtoms(); osidx=nl+na; clidx=osidx+1
coords=np.vstack([p,q,[0,0,0],[0,np.sqrt(2.40**2-1.4**2),-1.4]])
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(syms)}\nOs(II) eta6-p-cymene NN-chelate chloride cation; charge +1\n')
 for s,r in zip(syms,coords): f.write(f'{s:2} {r[0]: .8f} {r[1]: .8f} {r[2]: .8f}\n')
Chem.MolToMolFile(lig,'ligand.mol'); Chem.MolToMolFile(ar,'arene.mol')
json.dump({'n_lig':nl,'n_arene':na,'Os':osidx,'Cl':clidx,'N1':28,'N3':6,'arene_ring':[nl+i for i in ring]},open('indices.json','w'))
print('Ligand N-N distance',d,'Os',osidx,'Cl',clidx,'arene', [nl+i for i in ring], 'total atoms',len(syms))
PY
